doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 严格控制产能扩张，加快淘汰落后产能，推动上下游企业重组
quote_en: Strictly control capacity expansion, speed up scrapping of backward capacity and promote up/downstream restructuring.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan; guiding principle 控制总量、淘汰落后产能、加强技术改造、推进企业重组; also stabilise markets (保市场稳定), 国家收储, 直购电 pilots. Dominant = supply control (judgement); L1-wide.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 今后三年原则上不再核准新建、改扩建电解铝项目
quote_en: For the next three years, in principle no new or expanded electrolytic aluminium projects will be approved.
notes: Also scrap 800,000 t of small prebake-cell capacity by end-2010. Support side: 推进直购电试点 and 铝电联营 for leading smelters; 铝企业与煤炭、电力企业跨行业重组.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 按期完成淘汰反射炉及鼓风炉炼铜产能
quote_en: Complete on schedule the elimination of reverberatory- and blast-furnace copper capacity.
notes: 2009 target: 300,000 t of backward copper smelting capacity scrapped; copper named in 严格控制铜、铅、锌、钛、镁新增产能.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 逐步淘汰能耗高、污染重的落后烧结机铅冶炼产能
quote_en: Gradually eliminate energy-intensive, heavily polluting sintering-machine lead smelting capacity.
notes: 2009 target: 600,000 t of backward lead smelting capacity scrapped; 烧结锅炼铅 also eliminated.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 2009年，淘汰落后铜冶炼产能30万吨、铅冶炼产能60万吨、锌冶炼产能40万吨
quote_en: In 2009, eliminate backward copper (300,000 t), lead (600,000 t) and zinc (400,000 t) smelting capacity.
notes: Quantitative target; also 完成淘汰落后锌冶炼产能.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 严格控制铜、铅、锌、钛、镁新增产能
quote_en: Strictly control new capacity in copper, lead, zinc, titanium and magnesium.
notes: Titanium and magnesium appear only in this five-item list.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 有色金属深加工与新材料
concept_en: nonferrous deep processing and new materials
quote_zh: 支持填补国内空白、满足国民经济重点领域需要的高精尖深加工项目
quote_en: Support high-end, precision deep-processing projects that fill domestic gaps and meet key national needs.
notes: Also 大力开发新产品和新材料 for aerospace, defence and high-tech; target: high-grade copper/aluminium processed products broadly meet domestic demand by 2011; 支持中西部地区发展深加工.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快建设覆盖全社会的有色金属再生利用体系
quote_en: Speed up building a society-wide nonferrous metals recycling system.
notes: Targets: recycled copper 35% and aluminium 25% of output by 2011; lines of 300,000 t/y and above.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 有色金属矿产资源开发
quote_zh: 加大境外资源开发力度，支持具备条件的企业到境外独资或合资办矿
quote_en: Step up overseas resource development and support qualified firms to run mines abroad wholly or jointly.
notes: Targets: raw-material security of copper 40%, aluminium 56%, nickel 38% by 2011. Also 鼓励大型有色金属企业投资矿山勘探与开发; stricter mining-right market access (regulatory).
